questions.prompt: Which data structure follows last-in, first-out order?
questions.explanation: A stack removes the most recently added element first.

questions.prompt: What is the time complexity of binary search on a sorted array?
questions.explanation: Each step halves the remaining search range.

questions.prompt: What is the worst-case time complexity of quicksort with consistently poor pivots?
questions.explanation: Unbalanced partitions lead to n levels of O(n) work.

questions.prompt: What is the amortised cost of appending to a dynamic array that doubles when full?
questions.explanation: Occasional O(n) resizes are spread across many cheap appends, giving O(1) amortised.
